# A test reaches through a recursive component -- `c.s.next`, and the same
# through one copy of it, `c.r[1].next` -- for a prop, a node's prop, a
# method, a trigger and an event fired on the instance, on every target. On
# bubbletea a recursion keeps no state and renders no focus stop, so what
# reaches it there is the stateless half (recursion); an event fired on such
# an instance runs the handler chain its call sites wrote, up to the test's
# instance. The rest of the six take the stateful halves too (counters, an
# instance's own vars and methods, and buttons a trigger clicks).

sngl test --platform=none recursion.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html recursion.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

! sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go counters.sngl
stderr 'the recursive component "step" declares state of its own'

-- recursion.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, label string, @hit(n int)) node {
    func twice(n int) int {
        return n * 2
    }
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{label}{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, label=label, @hit(n) {
                hit(n)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, label="s", @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
        for var d = ["x", "y"] {
            step #r(depth=0, label=d, @hit(n) {
                last = n + 10
            })
        }
    }
}

func testRecursion(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.s.depth == 0)
    if c.s.next != null {
        t.assert(c.s.next.depth == 1)
        t.assert(c.s.next.label == "s")
        t.assert(c.s.next.twice(4) == 8)
        t.assert(c.s.next.b.value == "s1")
        c.s.next.hit(7)
        t.assert(c.last == 7)
    }
    t.assert(c.r[1].label == "y")
    t.assert(c.r[1].twice(3) == 6)
    if c.r[1].next != null {
        t.assert(c.r[1].next.label == "y")
        t.assert(c.r[1].next.b.value == "y1")
        c.r[1].next.hit(3)
        t.assert(c.last == 13)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- counters.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    var hits = 0
    func bump() {
        hits = hits + 1
    }
    vbox {
        button #b(text="{depth}:{hits}", @click {
            bump()
            hit(depth)
        })
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
        for var d = [5, 6] {
            step #r(depth=d)
        }
    }
}

func testRecursion(t Test, c main) {
    c.s.b.click()
    t.assert(c.s.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.last == 0)
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.b.click()
        c.s.next.b.click()
        t.assert(c.s.next.hits == 2)
        t.assert(c.s.next.depth == 1)
        c.s.next.bump()
        t.assert(c.s.next.hits == 3)
        t.assert(c.s.hits == 1)
    }
    c.r[1].bump()
    t.assert(c.r[1].hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.r[0].hits == 0)
    c.s.hit(9)
    t.assert(c.last == 9)
}

window {
    main
}
-- buttons.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, label string, @hit(n int)) node {
    func twice(n int) int {
        return n * 2
    }
    vbox {
        button #b(text="{label}{depth}", @click {
            hit(depth)
        })
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, label=label, @hit(n) {
                hit(n)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, label="s", @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
        for var d = ["x", "y"] {
            step #r(depth=0, label=d, @hit(n) {
                last = n + 10
            })
        }
    }
}

func testRecursion(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.s.depth == 0)
    if c.s.next != null {
        t.assert(c.s.next.depth == 1)
        t.assert(c.s.next.label == "s")
        t.assert(c.s.next.twice(4) == 8)
        c.s.next.b.click()
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
        c.s.next.hit(7)
        t.assert(c.last == 7)
    }
    t.assert(c.r[1].label == "y")
    t.assert(c.r[1].twice(3) == 6)
    if c.r[1].next != null {
        t.assert(c.r[1].next.label == "y")
        c.r[1].next.b.click()
        t.assert(c.last == 11)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
